verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev's evidence covers task orchestration, observability via TRQL queries, alerts, and building AI agents as tasks, but there is no evidence of the product itself generating AI-driven insights or suggestions about the user's own data (e.g., run/queue analytics with AI commentary). This is a plausible feature for an observability-heavy platform, so absence of evidence yields 'none' rather than 'na'.
